== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Iron Legion]] [[Pawns]] are grotesque, humanoid abominations produced by the [[Iron Legion]]. They are constructed from a combination of organic flesh and mechanical parts, often utilizing leftover materials from the creation of other [[Legion]] entities. Physically, they are described as resembling four-limbed [[spiders]] composed of corpses and machinery, sometimes featuring a humanoid head that emerges from a metallic shell. Due to their twisted appearance, encountering them can cause profound psychological shock and instinctive revulsion in soldiers, requiring specialized training to manage. In combat roles, [[Pawns]] serve as the standard infantry for the [[Legion]] and are frequently found in large numbers within [[Iron Hives]] or stationed aboard short-range boarding devices known as [[Penetrators]]. They are often deployed in groups alongside other specialized units like [[Sentries]], Shepherds, or [[Reavers]]. The [[Legion]] utilizes these creatures to spread like a virus, consuming both organic and mechanical matter to replicate their forces. If captured or defeated, individuals risk being converted into [[Pawns]] themselves.}}
